inventions.title: Thermoresponsive hydrogel for sustained siRNA release
inventions.summary: An injectable polymer gel that is liquid at room temperature, sets at body temperature and releases siRNA over about four weeks.

inventions.title: Low-cost microfluidic patch for continuous sweat lactate
inventions.summary: A disposable skin patch whose printed channels pull sweat across an enzymatic sensor, giving lactate readings every few minutes during exercise.
